question: By whose power and agency does the yoginī named Icchā extend up to māyā?
premises: Supreme will enables reaching up to māyā
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to māyā.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and the rest of the verse is compressed
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, reaches up to māyā.
